author: Diabolicx
body:
I don't have the xml for this map yet, if it does get accepted I'll write it. The map's layout is also being completely reworked, and the thread will be updated once the map is done.

Skyward Valley is a CTW map I built with TempestTemplar and Radstock2, and was originally meant for OCN but we never managed to fully release it there. The team sizes are yet to be decided, but we were aiming for 10v10. Spawn kit is included in the imgur album below. I'm also submitting the map to dev_revs' ctw contest.




More Screenshots: http://imgur.com/a/ukGSj
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/z1wrkx5oacw70cp/Skyward_Valley.zip
XML: coming soon

replies.author: Diabolicx
replies.body: Well im working on an update to the layout, but i think the void concept will stay the same. The map will be enclosed in a cuboid, and you can build wherever you want inside that cuboid. The max build height will probably be something around 15 blocks, and the cuboid's bottom will be right under the islands, to prevent underbridging. One thing im still not certain about is the inside of the islands. Do i leave it hollow or completely fill it up with bedrock ?

replies.body: Fill it with stone or bedrock, your choice. Also, a CTW isn't ideally just open game for people to build where they want. We don't really want to bring that meta here, it'll just be like sky wars...
